root_cause: Attacker-controlled configuration reaches InitialContext.lookup and JNDI LDAP lookup without constraining the remote factory.
abstract_pattern: Untrusted JNDI name flows into LDAP/RMI lookup.
trigger_condition: A crafted LDAP URL is accepted as a lookup target.
fix_strategy: Allowlist schemes and disable remote JNDI factories.
impact: Remote lookup may cross a network boundary.

root_cause: Attacker-controlled webhook URL is passed to an HTTP client without host allowlist or private address blocking.
abstract_pattern: Webhook callback URL reaches outbound HTTP request.
data_flow: webhook field -> URL object -> HTTP client fetch
trigger_condition: The webhook points to the metadata service.
fix_strategy: Validate scheme and host and block private address ranges.
impact: The server can be forced to request internal services.
